name: bandit.phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live generated-fog optical forest row. A real idle camp dispatches an abstract exact pair toward three concrete hostile entities; the remote weather penalty must reduce its optical budget to three and leave the one-OMT forest screen unacquired.

steps.label: post_load_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the generated-fog optical forest/horde fixture reaches normal gameplay; this is startup footing only
steps.failure_rule: If gameplay does not load, no live visibility proof can be credited.

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_site
steps.abort_reason: saved state did not contain the idle five-member camp and exact forest lead before the visibility run
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members and one fixture-known forest bounty are idle before production dispatch

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_horde
steps.abort_reason: saved overmap metadata did not contain three concrete hostile entities on the exact forest target OMT
steps.expected_immediate_state: three distinct concrete mon_zombie entities occupy the exact committed target OMT before runtime

steps.label: wait_first_6_hours_toward_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_due
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: six real game hours pass while production initializes the exact camp's routine activation clock
steps.failure_rule: If the first bounded wait does not complete, the deterministic dispatch window is not reached.

steps.label: wait_second_6_hours_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_dispatch
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the real hourly cadence crosses the exact camp's due boundary and dispatches an exact pair toward the committed forest target
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded wait lacks the exact dispatch artifact, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_observer
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: one real game hour advances the optical pair to its route-facing forest observation point and runs the production visibility read in generated fog
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded post-dispatch wait lacks a visibility artifact, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_artifact
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug delta did not prove the exact generated-fog optical forest block
steps.failure_rule: No generated-fog optical row credit if dispatch and exact blocked visibility outcome are not present on same-run lines.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_forbids_observed_target
steps.abort_reason: the fog-limited optical trace observed the forest target that should remain screened
steps.failure_rule: An observed threat on the forest target invalidates this fog-screen negative.

evidence_contract.claim: generated remote fog applies its 1.7 sight penalty to an actual optical outing member, reducing the budget to three and preventing acquisition through the one-OMT committed forward forest screen
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for structural visibility
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 generated-fog optical row credit unless startup, exact idle site/lead, exact three-entity target footing, elapsed production dispatch, generated fog, optic possession, reduced sight budget, blocked acquisition, and no-observed-target control are separately green.
